description: Returns weather reports sent by an APRS weather station for the last 1–48 hours: temperature (°C), humidity (%), pressure (hPa), wind direction (degrees), wind speed and gust (m/s), rain in the last hour and 24 hours (mm). Gives the latest report in full, minimum/maximum over the window for the main values, and an evenly thinned series (at most 48 points). Stations that do not send weather return an empty result.

callsign.description: Station callsign with optional SSID, for example TA4OHN-10. Case-insensitive.

hours.description: How far back to read weather reports, in hours (1–48, default 6).

name: get_station_weather
title: Get station weather reports
